name: Limited Speed Motor Vehicle
description: Any motor vehicle that can't reach 32 km/h on a clean, paved, level surface, other than a power-assisted bicycle or golf cart; an e-scooter lands here, as does an e-bike over 500 W that can't reach 32 km/h, and only the electric kick scooter among them may use a highway.

restrictions.rule: A maximum attainable speed under 32 km/h on a clean, paved, level surface; not a power-assisted bicycle or golf cart
restrictions.citation: The Limited Speed Motor Vehicle Regulations, R.R.S. c. T-18.1 Reg 19, s. 2

restrictions.rule: No driver's licence and no registration
restrictions.citation: The Limited Speed Motor Vehicle Regulations, R.R.S. c. T-18.1 Reg 19, ss. 4 and 5

restrictions.rule: Banned from every highway unless it's an electric kick scooter
restrictions.citation: The Limited Speed Motor Vehicle Regulations, R.R.S. c. T-18.1 Reg 19, s. 6(1)

restrictions.rule: An electric kick scooter has a standing platform, no seat or pedals, wheels no more than 430 mm across, electric motors totalling 500 W or less that can't propel it past 24 km/h, and weighs 45 kg or less
restrictions.citation: The Limited Speed Motor Vehicle Regulations, R.R.S. c. T-18.1 Reg 19, s. 2(1)

restrictions.rule: An electric kick scooter may use a highway only where a municipality or park has passed bylaws allowing it, never one with a speed limit over 50 km/h unless the bylaws keep it in a bike lane there, and must use a bike lane where one exists
restrictions.citation: The Limited Speed Motor Vehicle Regulations, R.R.S. c. T-18.1 Reg 19, ss. 6(2), 7 and 8

restrictions.rule: Electric kick scooter riders must be 16 or older, and on a highway wear a motorcycle helmet or a CSA, ANSI, ASTM or Snell bicycle helmet
restrictions.citation: The Limited Speed Motor Vehicle Regulations, R.R.S. c. T-18.1 Reg 19, ss. 6(3) and 13

restrictions.rule: An electric kick scooter carries no passenger and tows nothing, is ridden standing with a hand on the handlebar and not abreast of other vehicles, and needs a bell or horn, plus front and rear lights from half an hour after sunset to half an hour before sunrise
restrictions.citation: The Limited Speed Motor Vehicle Regulations, R.R.S. c. T-18.1 Reg 19, ss. 11, 12 and 14
